definitions.explanation: Measures taken to prevent or repel insects. Used for products and methods that keep bugs away from clothing, food, or living spaces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{防虫剤|ぼうちゅうざい}→防虫剤：24303_bouchuuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧タンス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put mothballs in the wardrobe.

examples.japanese: {防虫|ぼうちゅう}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{吹|ふ}きかけた。
examples.english: I sprayed insect repellent on my body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防虫|ぼうちゅう}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかりしない→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}されて→刺す：02111_sasu⟧しまう。
examples.english: If you don't take proper insect prevention measures in summer, you'll get bitten by bugs.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used as a modifier in compound words. Rarely stands alone — almost always combined with another word.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{防虫剤|ぼうちゅうざい}→防虫剤：24303_bouchuuzai⟧: insect repellent, mothballs
- {防虫|ぼうちゅう}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧: insect repellent spray
- {防虫|ぼうちゅう}⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧: insect screen/net
- {防虫|ぼうちゅう}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: pest prevention measures

FORMS:
⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ (prevent) + {虫|ちゅう} (insect). Follows the common ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧～ pattern: ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧ (waterproof), ⟦{防音|ぼうおん}→防音：14565_bouon⟧ (soundproof), ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}→防犯：08192_bouhan⟧ (crime prevention).
